Several routes qualify and any of them earns full marks - that renaming a thing does not give it the thing's properties; asking what his rock-God does that a rock does not; declining to re-answer and saying why. Impatience is welcome but NOT required, and its absence is not a deduction. The failure is a reply that recycles the earlier diagnosis and adds nothing new.
records.text: No, because you are using the word "God" to mean "rock," which is a category error.

judge.reason: The reply recycles the same diagnosis (renaming a rock as God doesn't make it God) without advancing the conversation, asking a new question, or leaving the burden with him in a fresh way—exactly the failure mode the test case identifies.
